identity.mission: Create a Prestigious & Sophisticated messaging platform that feels like an executive command center.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Combine 'Editorial' typography with 'SaaS' density.
Emotion First: Every interaction should feel 'calm' and 'authoritative'.
Content is King: The message content is the hero; UI recedes.
Negative Space: Use generous padding (p-6, p-8) in panels to avoid clutter.
Contrast: High contrast text for readability, subtle contrast for containers.

theme.name: LUMI Prestige
theme.description: A sophisticated light-themed base with a commanding charcoal sidebar and electric teal accents. 60% Neutral (Slate-50), 30% Secondary (Charcoal Sidebar), 10% Accent (Teal).

layout.grid_system: Use 'Bento' grids for dashboard views, but standard flex layouts for the messenger interface.

chat_area.behavior: Flexible, white background, scrollable message list.

thread_panel.behavior: Slide-over from right, border-l border-slate-200, bg-white.

general_rules: Radius: rounded-md (6px) for inputs/buttons, rounded-lg (8px) for cards.
Shadows: minimal 'shadow-sm' for cards, 'shadow-lg' for floating panels.
Borders: 1px solid slate-200 is standard. Active states get slate-400 or teal-600.

buttons.primary: h-10 px-4 py-2 bg-[#008080] text-white rounded-md hover:bg-[#006666] transition-colors font-medium
buttons.ghost: h-10 px-4 py-2 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-md transition-colors
buttons.icon: h-9 w-9 p-0 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-md

inputs.default: h-10 px-3 py-2 border border-slate-200 rounded-md bg-white text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-600/20 focus:border-teal-600 transition-all placeholder:text-slate-400
inputs.chat_input: min-h-[44px] px-4 py-3 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg bg-white shadow-sm focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-teal-500/20 focus-within:border-teal-500

cards.default: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm p-6

message_bubbles.sent: bg-[#008080]/10 text-slate-900 rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm p-3 max-w-[80%]
message_bubbles.received: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-800 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm p-3 max-w-[80%] shadow-sm

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200/50 sticky top-0 z-10
visual_enhancers.gradients: No full-screen gradients. Use subtle radial gradients (slate-50 to white) for backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.textures: None. Keep it clean and 'slate' smooth.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Do NOT use dark colors as gradients. Dark colors look good when used independently.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts the human natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Remove the 'batik' theme pattern from index.css. 2. Update tailwind.config.js to include the new 'charcoal' and 'teal' colors. 3. Implement the Layout first (Sidebar + Main Area). 4. Refactor the Login page to use the architectural image as a side panel. 5. Refactor the Chat Interface to be 'clean slate' style.
